description: Measured fast-near evaluator values for the 52-point validation set (20 interior, 16 face, 16 outside per configuration), one row per point with all six normalized field components; input is the exact-field reference fastnear_reference_52pt.csv
commit_note: working tree above 7e34ff4 (exact s-space wiring); generated before the wiring commit was created

generator.self_test_result: PASS (5 points, deterministic; fast matches independent exact evaluator <1e-2)

determinism.note: two runs on this host are byte-identical; the CPU pointwise evaluator is host-independent

notes: Values are the picBunch fast-near evaluator (picBunch::pbfast::shape_field) at unit cells, compared against the independent exact-field reference in fastnear_reference_52pt.csv. The exact s-space evaluator now handles every in-support pair, so the interior errors drop to 2.3e-7 (g1), 2.2e-7 (g10-axial) and 2.1e-5 (g10-oblique) from the previous 6.8e-4, 1.4e-4 and 1.9e-3. Face points sit exactly on the support boundary and outside points remain on the tolerance/gamma-derived smooth-remainder quadrature, so those rows are unchanged and still reproduce tab:fast to <1%. CPU-only: no alpaka, CUDA, or FFTW is linked.
